name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: what looked like mass duplicate items after a sync was actually mass mislabeling. Federated items never had any MetadataField locked, so Jellyfin's own local metadata providers (TMDb, OMDb, ...) were free to run their own 'identify' search against them and overwrite fields this plugin already populated from the remote's own canonical data. Confirmed live: dozens of Plex-sourced movies with weak source metadata all ended up displaying the exact same wrong, unrelated title from one bad shared search match - looking like the same movie duplicated a dozen times, when they were actually a dozen distinct movies (different IMDb ids, confirmed correct in this plugin's own cache) all mislabeled identically. Every field this plugin sets (Name, Overview, OfficialRating, Genres, Studios, Tags, Runtime) is now locked on materialization, and a self-heal pass restamps the correct Name (and backfills the lock) on any already-affected item from before this fix, without losing its watch history. 266 tests, all green.
